title: Cisco raises Acacia purchase price to about $4.5B

sources.quote: Cisco has agreed to acquire Acacia for $115 per share in cash, or approximately $4.5 billion on a fully diluted basis, net of cash and marketable securities.

explain: After Acacia tried to walk away from the original deal, Cisco agreed to pay $115 a share (about $4.5 billion), up from $70. The deal closed in March 2021, giving Cisco its own coherent optics for data center and network links.
